commit_message: Integrate ADR0155 managed Local AI backend
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR0155 managed Local AI
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements the ADR 0155 managed llama.cpp backend and AI Studio setup flow on top of the managed runtime core. Adds WindowsNative/WSL2 execution identity, demand-driven loopback inference, explicit GGUF registration/copy approval, runtime setup/removal, resource lifecycle integration, benchmark provenance, and additive Ollama migration semantics.
